response: Research suggests that paucigranulocytic asthmatics, who have lower levels of granulocytes (a type of white blood cell) in their sputum, may still exhibit systemic inflammation. Although their sputum may appear less inflammatory due to the lower granulocyte count, they can have elevated levels of inflammatory markers in their blood, indicating an underlying inflammatory process. This challenges the notion that paucigranulocytic asthmatics are non-inflammatory, as they may still experience inflammation, but with different characteristics than other asthma phenotypes.
